presentation.name: Yvan SANSON
presentation.text: Full stack engineer with 6 years of experience in various domains, ranging from medical devices to AI. I also have some DevOps experience, and I'm learning systems programming with my personal projects.

corpy.team: 6 engineers, 2 data scientists, 1 UI/UX designer, 1 PM
corpy.description: Full-stack engineer on Corpy's flagship BtoB MLOps platform, also contributing to R&D projects, infrastructure and QA. I work on high performance data ingestion and processing systems, as well as image inference and dataset management.
highlights: I built a licensing system with cryptographic hardware tying and OTA validation, for cloud and offline deployments
I took ownership of the CI/CD pipeline, cutting deployment time and helping sales team better understand the platform
I helped build some image inference pipeline, targeting sub 20ms inference and response time
I created a custom installer for offline deployments in our clients' environments

sncf.description: Tech lead for a team of 3–5 building a web app that streamlined IaaS/PaaS server provisioning. It still is the company's reference tool today, with dozens of deployments across multiple teams each day.
highlights: I built and open sourced a custom dynamic form generator driven by Terraform parameters to allow users to build their own deployment form.
We reduced user errors by 70% through workflow and UI improvements
I integrated with company-wide OIDC authentication for faster and easier access to the platform

uromems.team: 3 mobile engineers, 7 low-level engineers, 1 Test / QA engineer
uromems.description: I improved the Android app controlling a medical implant over a custom Bluetooth protocol at this medtech startup, then helped rebuild it in Kotlin. We were a 3 people team, working closely with the hardware teams to ensure the app was conform to the high standards of this product.
highlights: I participated in the overhaul of the Bluetooth communication and low-level byte decoding layer
We rebuilt the new app's Bluetooth layer in Kotlin using coroutines for better concurrency and performance
I added test suites meeting ISO 62304 medical software requirements, along with proper documentation and archiving.

ecam.description: Built a web app for ECAM, a French engineering school, connecting students with companies offering internships, replacing a fully manual process. I started with only the frontend, but progressed to the backend as well as we needed faster release times.
highlights: I designed and implemented the frontend following the specifications provided by the client
I turned the client's workflow into technical specifications
We cut the school staff's internship-handling time by more than 60%

education.degree: Engineering diploma (Master's degree) in Computer Science and Management
education.description: Focused on software programming and design. The program combined 2 years of undergraduate studies with 3 years of engineering coursework, including 3 internships — the latter two in an engineering setting.

projects.intro: A selection of personal projects I've built to learn new languages, explore systems programming, and go deep into how stuff works. Source code is hosted on GitHub and GitLab.

veloVista.description: An iOS and watchOS app, built entirely in SwiftUI following modern Apple patterns and practices, that saves bike rides from Apple's Fitness app, manages multiple bikes, and tracks their maintenance items.

rsTorrent.description: A BitTorrent client written in Rust for educational purposes, exploring peer-to-peer networking and binary protocol parsing.

interpreterGo.description: My take on the well-known 'Writing An Interpreter In Go' book: a lexer, parser and evaluator for a small custom language.

gitGud.description: An experimental terminal user interface for browsing and interacting with Git repositories, written in Go.

simpleFormBuilder.description: A simple, schema-driven form builder and generator for React applications.

nyaaBrowser.description: A desktop app to browse and search recently added torrents on Nyaa.si.

focalStats.description: A small utility to compute focal statistics for a single picture or a whole folder of images.
